data_policy: Only actual public funding history events. Snapshot rates, prices and intervals are not copied. OKX uses realizedRate. Missing prices and unverified intervals are empty. Timestamps retain original milliseconds.
identity_policy: Snapshot base and symbol preserved; multiplier prefixes are distinct. Missing venue/base pairs are not mapped to differently named bases.
interval_policy: Inferred from retained actual settlement spacings only; completeness means consistent observed spacing, not independent proof of schedule.
